result.keywords: AbstractThis article investigates a granularity-aware hybrid framework for incomplete decision systems and skeleton-based posture recognition. A multi-level feature descriptor combining local angle cues, distance relationships, and knowledge granularity measures is constructed to enhance robustness under missing data. The proposed method integrates incremental attribute reduction with rule learning and ensemble sampling to improve interpretability and classification accuracy. Experiments on benchmark posture datasets and incomplete tabular datasets demonstrate stable performance across varied sparsity levels.

result.title: Granularity-aware posture rule reduction for incomplete skeleton decision systems
